title: Pant-hoot call made by a male chimpanzee
author: Pawel Fedurek et al.
changes: Recording of a chimpanzee (Pan troglodytes) pant-hoot, a fellow great ape, standing in for the gorilla (no free gorilla vocal recording was found). Trimmed to 3.90–6.52 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
